theorem.does_not_prove: Full T_i-stability of N_0 over S; commutator defects in N_0 over S; exactness F/N_0 ≅ R/J. Specialized fibre T-stability from the P25Z packet is not reused as a proof over S.
theorem.proves: On every basis component of degree 1 or 2, the degree-four piece (N_0)_4 fills the whole ambient S_{4−deg b}·e_b. Consequently every T_i(s_a) and every commutator defect automatically lies in (N_0)_4 on those components. The only open membership is the pure-q (degree-0) component inside S_4.
theorem.scope: All ranks and spans are exact over F_89. Empty special fibre would still imply empty generic fibre by the sealed DVR properness theorem; that direction does not require presentation exactness.
